capabilities.capability: Mental command training, PCA and Gaussian classification · Calibrate
capabilities.status_scope: Independent Python and native Swift training/inference/evaluation with synthetic and reference-vector tests; no physiologically validated participant model or actionable output
capabilities.body_evidence: Selected bounded body evidence now exists: docs/MENTAL_REFERENCE_TRACE.md and evidence/mental-command-reference/manifest.json establish named feature-selection/PCA/canonical/Gaussian-density/posterior call sites and neutral-training state. Complete raw-to-feature path, numeric settings and vendor-trained state remain unresolved. Follow-up docs/MENTAL_CALLER_DATAFLOW.md traces the canonical argument to a probability-element collection count and identifies repeated weighted density accumulation; action mapping, normalized mixture semantics and runtime parameters remain unknown. Our one-Gaussian-per-class design is not equivalent to that observed path. docs/MENTAL_POSTERIOR_DATAFLOW.md further traces the selected-column minimum, appended scalar-weighted entry and shared denominator; helper semantics, neutral identity and sensitivity mapping remain unresolved.
capabilities.missing_parameters_assets_dependencies: Prospective independent task/neutral sessions, artifact controls and ordinary-activity exposure; physical cue audibility/timing and native headset lifecycle qualification. Queued recording and acknowledged trial writes exist, but sustained capture with concurrent inference needs hardware measurement. Live collection/review is not established by the synthetic imported-dataset workflow. Vendor weights/settings are neither required nor imported.
capabilities.current_implementation: Python processing/mental.py and the native EEGCore implement train-only scaling/feature ranking, PCA, diagonal Gaussian classification including neutral, score/distance rejection and persistence. Native profile creation and integrity-checked local storage, finalized-recording dataset loading, held-out labeled evaluation, exposure/cue metrics and provenance receipts now exist. EEGEvaluate uses the same native receipt/evaluation entry point as the app. Output remains experimental and system control disabled. This is an independent design, not a recovered vendor algorithm. Native planned speech trials, persisted/recovered transition evidence, balanced seeded order, rest/timing gates and source-pinned dataset building now feed native training and held-out evaluation. Acquisition now feeds a bounded shadow-only consumer using shared window inference, with explicit profile start/stop, separate recorded results and stale-result invalidation. This live integration remains hardware-unqualified. Class-specific and per-session metrics include explicit rejection counts and unavailable denominators; artifact-control trials export as evaluation-only neutral conditions. Versioned retraining preserves parent identity without claiming inherited validation. Whole-trial and per-session summaries retain missing cues and eligible exposure. Optional session resampling is exploratory, not validated confidence coverage. Native dataset loading checks exact cross-session excerpts; receipts audit which saved-profile training sources are present. Detector persistence rejects negative and overlapping timing. Complete historical model-selection provenance and prospective physiological qualification remain absent. Evaluation receipts and UI now include an always-neutral comparator with pooled/per-session window metrics and cued-trial counts; missing cue evidence remains unavailable and no significance or qualification is inferred. Pooled and per-session command confusion retains every predicted-label cell and a separate rejection count, exposing wrong-command substitutions without collapsing them into aggregate errors. Full-evaluation minimum windows per class is configurable in the native UI and CLI, default ten, with receipt provenance and explicit invalid/insufficient-data failures; it is not a physiological sufficiency threshold. A native conditional trial-plan association primitive counts only balanced maximum-run-three schedules, with independent exhaustive synthetic checks. An internal adapter checks recovered complete reviewed plans, source digest, identity, exact trial timing and caller-selected exposure eligibility before comparison. Optional native app/CLI comparison now binds actual evaluator outputs and source digests into v12 receipts, with per-session unavailable reasons and no result for incomplete evidence. Synthetic complete-plan evaluation preserves predictions; focused macOS unavailable and eligible complete-plan result/settings/export interaction is checked, including byte-identical canonical/UI/CLI receipts and checkbox/percentage invalidation; physiological qualification remains pending. No validated significance or physiological claim is made.
capabilities.target_component: One mental-processing service and versioned profile contract, consumed by the native Calibration workspace. Offline Python processing.workflow is the first research implementation, not a second user-facing application.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Synthetic numerical/state/profile tests plus real prospective whole-session evaluation with independently verified task labels, no content reuse, artifact controls, neutral exposure and uncertainty. Native port must match fixed reference vectors before physical integration; outputs stay disabled.
capabilities.delivery_notes: The macOS import/train/inspect/evaluate/export path was exercised with synthetic recordings at d63f9de, with saved profile and exported report compared against the fixture evaluator. Automatic profile-list refresh was subsequently checked at the UI level. The native report step now persists optional manual observer notes through the canonical trial journal, with a roundtrip test preserving notes while rejecting uncertain-report acceptance. Notes are declarations, not synchronized behavioral ground truth. Real cue collection, cross-session physiology and artifact dependence remain unqualified. See docs/qualification/NATIVE_UI_WORKFLOW.md and docs/NATIVE_WORKFLOW_AUDIT.md for exact scopes.

capabilities.current_implementation: Python processing/mental.py and native EEGCore implement the independently designed PCA/regularized diagonal-Gaussian pipeline. EEGMentalProfile validates v2 profile integrity, dimensions, provenance and disabled output; makeDetector constructs EEGExperimentalDetector. EEGReplayInference and EEGLiveInference consume the shared native window-inference path. Native profile training/save and held-out evaluation/export have been exercised interactively with synthetic recordings. No Cortex runtime, vendor TFLite weights or proprietary model assets are used. Profile loaders also reject PCA bases inconsistent with orthonormality, variances below the declared floor and distance limits below the trainer minimum, even with recomputed checksums. This checks recipe consistency, not provenance or accuracy.

capabilities.acceptance_gate: Golden inference vectors, corrupt/incompatible model rejection, reproducible preprocessing, memory/latency and rollback tests.
capabilities.delivery_notes: Native runtime is implemented and software-tested; it is no longer pending. Canonical receipt construction now observes cooperative cancellation; a deterministic regression rejects cancelled output and confirms an unchanged independent retry. The macOS synthetic UI workflow is documented in docs/qualification/NATIVE_UI_WORKFLOW.md. These checks do not establish vendor algorithm equivalence, physiological accuracy or safe command output.

capabilities.status_scope: Local JSONL/reference, one-minute-per-rate recording load and three-minute concurrent recording/inference synthetic load tested; prolonged native hardware qualification pending
capabilities.body_evidence: Symbol/class evidence only; routine bodies not established for this category.
capabilities.missing_parameters_assets_dependencies: Native durability/failure-status qualification, indexed library and prolonged recording tests.
capabilities.current_implementation: Native append-only JSONL raw/sample/event records, completion/schema validation, library review, bounded replay/CSV export and analysis. Shared reads detect size/timestamp or named-inode changes and reject provisional results. Python archive and RecordingLibrary also exist; cue markers and reference Parquet recovery remain research evidence. Trial transitions and plans are recorded and recovered with shared revision checks; aborted writers omit completion. Failed summary writes/flushes attempt rollback and expose uncertainty if rollback fails. Native acquisition uses a bounded serial recording queue for high-rate writes; operational events and acknowledged trial revisions share that queue. Trial state publishes only after persistence acknowledgement; late or failed acknowledgements cannot advance cues. Finalization runs off the UI queue, although orderly application shutdown can still wait for disk operations. Offline queue tests cover order, overload, disk failure, incomplete abort and restart; physical throughput is unqualified. A three-minute synthetic concurrent run preserved 23,040 samples and matched 90 full inference windows to replay, with zero discarded inputs or write failures. Whole-test-process resident memory was sampled, not native UI or hardware memory.
capabilities.target_component: One recording service owns acquisition, metadata, markers, library index and completion/failure state.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Disk failure/crash recovery, exclusive private writes, schema/count validation, corruption reporting and complete export round trips.
capabilities.delivery_notes: Core implemented; long-session durability/indexing qualification pending.
